description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Earth], [Awoken Earth], [Damage Cap +10000], [Earthen Wisdom Mode], [Earthen Wisdom Instant Cast] and [Sage's Strike Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Earth
description.text: Earth abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Earthen Wisdom Mode
description.text: Randomly casts Gaia's Grace, Tellah's Faith or Memory of the Land after using an Earth ability

description.name: Earthen Wisdom Instant Cast
description.text: Instant cast speed for Earth abilities, removed if the character hasn't [Earthen Wisdom Mode]

description.name: Sage's Strike Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Sage's Strike after using three Earth abilities
